newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: U.S. mission plans $2.5 mln Bahrain hospital.
newsitem.headline: U.S. mission plans $2.5 mln Bahrain hospital.

text.p: The American Mission Hospital in Bahrain plans to set up a new hospital on the Gulf Arab island for 950,000 dinars ($2.5 million).
American Mission Hospital chief medical officer Paul Armerding said on Monday the hospital plans to finance the new five-storey complex through fund-raising campaigns over two years.

Bahrain's Emir Sheikh Isa bin Sulman al-Khalifa has helped start "our fund-raising process with a very generous contribution to the American Mission Hospital future fund," he said without elaborating.
The current 40-bed American Mission Hospital was built in 1926. Armerding said the new building would have a similar capacity.
